findings.title: getSubGroupsCount returns null for a concurrently deleted group
findings.body: When the group is deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() returns null and getSubGroupsCount() now returns null instead of throwing. Callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass this straight to representation.setSubGroupCount(...), and other callers may unbox the Long. The NPE can then move to those callers, or the API silently reports a null count for a group that no longer exists. The other methods in this adapter (getSubGroupsStream with search/paging, getDelegateForUpdate) either dereference modelSupplier.get() directly or throw IllegalStateException when the group is not found, so this method is also inconsistent with them.

findings.title: Racy test with an unjoined thread and weak assertion
findings.body: The reader thread is started but never joined. After deletedAll is set, the main thread asserts immediately, so an exception thrown by an in-flight request can be missed. The thread is not a daemon and is never awaited, so it can outlive the test and keep calling the server during cleanup. The loop has no pause, which hammers the server. The test also only passes or fails by timing, so it may not reliably reproduce the NPE. Join the thread before asserting.

findings.title: Unrelated dead-code removal bundled in the fix
findings.body: The removal of the unused groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement method (and likely the now-unused StringUtil import) has nothing to do with the NPE fix. It adds noise to the PR. If StringUtil is still imported elsewhere in the file, this is harmless, but it should be a separate cleanup.
